procedure: State: The calibrated route system may leave hidden contributions nonidentifiable and may have model mismatch. Procedure: Fit compatible waits, inspect structured residuals, choose up to two accessible routes that separate unresolved assignments, and refit. Distinguish persistent model mismatch from weak route coverage. Then run the ordinary matched sandbox pilot for an implicated handoff. Limits and stopping conditions: Finite error, model assumptions, insufficient route geometry and regime dependence remain explicit.

observables: Changes in compatible assignments, residual structure, route discrimination and matched pilot turnaround.
inferential_warrant: New route constraints test unresolved internal structure; the separate pilot supplies bounded evidence about a candidate change, not proof of a unique cause.
problem_decomposition: Separate hidden waits, observation coverage and possible model mismatch.
next_inquiry: Acquire routes for identifiability rather than volume; stop at two or when none distinguishes assignments, then select and report the bounded pilot.
